Yasuo

the Unforgiven
Mid laneTop laneBot lane

Bot lane Yasuo replaces the marksman with a melee crit carry. With a support who has knock-ups or protection, he can win lane with all-ins at levels 2 and 3, and he scales into a teamfight monster. He's currently one of the stronger picks in bot, but he needs a support that plays around him.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

Nerfed in patch 26.22: His Q scales a little less with attack damage, so crit builds hit slightly softer.
  • Q AD ratio: 105% total AD → 100% total AD
All patch changes →

When to pick Yasuo

✗ Better as a counter-pick

He depends on your support and loses to some marksmen, so pick him after you know who your support is.

Pick into

  • Immobile marksmen with projectile damage, like Ashe or Ezreal
  • Lanes where your support has knock-ups, like Rell or Nami
  • Enemy teams with lots of projectile ultimates
  • Short-trade marksmen like Lucian

Avoid into

  • Mobile kiters like Kalista or Xayah
  • Lanes with lots of crowd control, like Swain
  • Poke supports that won't let you farm
  • Teams that already have a melee carry in another lane and no ranged damage

Great teammates

NamiKnock-ups from her bubble and ultimate plus E empowerment.
JannaTornado knock-up and shields make your all-ins safe.
RellHard engage that knocks up multiple enemies.

Your team needs: A support with knock-ups or shields, and some ranged damage elsewhere in the team.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Strong level 2-3 all-ins with a support who has crowd control
  • Wind Wall blocks marksman auto-attacks and support skill shots in lane
  • Scales into a great teamfighter with Immortal Shieldbow and Infinity Edge
  • Supports with knock-ups give you constant Last Breath opportunities

Weaknesses

  • Melee in a lane against two ranged champions, so you take poke while farming
  • Very dependent on your support; with a poke support you struggle
  • Champions with dashes and long range, like Kalista and Xayah, beat your all-ins
  • Your damage was nerfed in 26.22 (Steel Tempest now 100% AD)

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: strong all-ins with a crowd control support
  • First item (Immortal Shieldbow): keeps you alive when you dive the marksman
  • Second item (Infinity Edge): huge crit damage, you start winning fights
  • Third item (Death's Dance): lets you survive in the middle of teamfights
  • Bot quest done: extra gold, and your boots move to the quest slot so you get a free item slot

Top tips

  • Hit level 2 first and all-in with your support
  • Use Wind Wall to block the enemy marksman's autos during trades
  • Exhaust the enemy marksman when you dive them
  • Always keep a minion nearby so you can Sweeping Blade out
  • Ult right away when your support knocks enemies up
  • Your bot quest moves boots to the quest slot; use the extra item slot for Guardian Angel late
  • Avoid long poke lanes; you can't farm well against two ranged champions without a support who protects you
